game.title: Tomb Raider I-III Remastered
game.blurb: Remastered collection of three classic Tomb Raider action-adventures and their expansion levels, from Aspyr Media and Crystal Dynamics, released 2024-02-13. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters follow the game prefixes in the Steam achievement names.

chapters.title: Tomb Raider I
chapters.summary: Peru, Greece, Egypt and Atlantis, with secrets, Lara's Home and many level stunts (achievements marked "TR1"). Spoiler-guarded where hidden.

chapters.title: Unfinished Business and Shadow of the Cat
chapters.summary: The first game's expansion levels (marked "TR:UB"): Shadow of the Cat, the Atlantean Stronghold and The Hive.

chapters.title: Tomb Raider II
chapters.summary: Venice, the Opera House, the Maria Doria, Tibet and the Temple of Xian (marked "TR2"). Spoiler-guarded where hidden.

chapters.title: Tomb Raider II: Golden Mask
chapters.summary: The second game's expansion levels on Melnikov Island (marked "TR2:GM").

chapters.title: Tomb Raider III
chapters.summary: India, Nevada, Polynesia, England and Antarctica (marked "TR3"). Spoiler-guarded where hidden.

chapters.title: The Lost Artifact
chapters.summary: The third game's expansion levels in Scotland, a tunnel and France (marked "TR3:LA").

chapters.title: Challenge Mode
chapters.summary: Levels replayed at higher CR ratings and with modifiers (marked "TRX:CM").

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Tomb_Raider_I-III_Remastered
Fandom (tombraider.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://tombraider.fandom.com/wiki/Tomb_Raider_I-III_Remastered
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). Every one of the 284 Steam achievements starts with a game prefix ("TR1", "TR:UB", "TR2", "TR2:GM", "TR3", "TR3:LA", "TRX:CM"), and chapters are placed by that prefix alone, so hidden ones (80 of 284) sit in their own game's chapter rather than one story chapter. Expansion chapter names come from achievement text ("Unfinished Business levels", "Shadow of the Cat levels", "Melnikov Island chapter", "Finish The Lost Artifact", "Challenge Mode"); Fandom's link list includes "Tomb Raider II: Golden Mask", "Tomb Raider III: The Lost Artefact" and "Tomb Raider: Unfinished Business". The Steam schema calls the app "Tomb Raider Classic Trilogy"; the store name is "Tomb Raider I-III Remastered Starring Lara Croft" (2478970). StrategyWiki has a page for the collection at completion stage 1, but it is a short overview with no subpages of its own; the original games have separate StrategyWiki pages ("Tomb Raider" at stage 1, "Tomb Raider II" at stage 0, "Tomb Raider III" at stage 1), which were not looked into or used. tombraider.fandom.com answers the API, with about 124 linked pages, including "Tomb Raider I-III Remastered/Walkthrough" and "Tomb Raider I-III Remastered/Achievements"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG lists a playtime of only 3 hours, which looks low for three games.
